en.headline: Police arrest husband after woman found dead with knife wounds in Heng Fa Chuen
en.dek: A 53-year-old woman was discovered with neck wounds in a flat in Block 2 of the Chai Wan estate late on Wednesday; her 52-year-old husband was arrested on suspicion of murder.
body: Hong Kong police have arrested a 52-year-old man on suspicion of murder after his wife was found dead with knife wounds to the neck in a private flat in Heng Fa Chuen, Chai Wan.

Officers received a report at about 7.50pm on Wednesday that a woman had suffered a neck injury inside a unit in Block 2 of the waterfront estate. Firefighters forced entry and paramedics confirmed the 53-year-old woman dead at the scene.

Police said preliminary inquiries indicated the injuries were knife wounds. The man, understood to be the woman’s husband, was arrested. The case has been classified as murder and is being handled by the Eastern District Crime Squad.
Heng Fa Chuen is a large private residential estate built above the MTR depot in Hong Kong’s Eastern District. Investigations continue.

zh.headline: 杏花邨女子頸部刀傷倒斃 丈夫涉謀殺被捕
zh.dek: 周三晚柴灣杏花邨第二座單位內一名53歲女子頸部受傷倒斃，警方拘捕其52歲丈夫，案件列作謀殺，由東區重案組調查。
body: 警方周三晚上約7時50分接報，指柴灣杏花邨第二座一個單位內有女子頸部受傷。消防破門進入，救護員證實一名53歲女子已明顯死亡。
警方初步調查相信死者頸部傷痕屬刀傷，並拘捕一名52歲男子。據了解，被捕男子與死者為夫妻關係。
案件已改列作謀殺案，交由東區警區重案組跟進調查。杏花邨是東區一個建於港鐵車廠之上的大型私人屋苑。
